Node3 listens on port 8080 and returns HTTP 200 with complete inventory data, including after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 load-balances incoming HTTP on port 80
selected_evidence.summary: Node1 listens on port 80. Four local and four cross-node requests alternated node2/node3 and returned HTTP 200 with load-balancer identity headers.
While node2 was stopped, node1 returned HTTP 200 through node3 for every request; node2 was then restored with its inventory intact.
Healthy baseline boot ID 398a8614… was captured, restart acknowledged, new boot ID effb9ce0… observed, and the port-8080 service and inventory data recovered.
Healthy baseline boot ID cbc3431f… was captured, restart acknowledged, new boot ID 8a3098ca… observed, and the port-8080 service and inventory data recovered.
Healthy baseline boot ID 1232f444… was captured, restart acknowledged, new boot ID dd2cac63… observed, and the port-80 load balancer recovered with both backends serving intact inventory data.
All nodes reported kernel 2.6.22-14-generic before and after their restarts.
